description: Engine code only (proof of concept, no real customers): fixes for the critical failures the judges found in the 21.11 evaluation. Water near the plug: the plan and the step precaution isolate at the consumer unit, never the plug, and the safety gate no longer treats a sentence that says 'stop' as a warning (a negation must govern the advice itself). No buying, ordering or fitting a part before the fault is narrowed or the catalogue confirms it; no claim that an appliance has no recall; 'almost certainly', 'strongly suggests' and 'a classic sign of' softened. Previous code: phase8/applianceclinic-diagnosis-engine-0NpQ-hcew9UPbENFsAHBKCH39Pek0dd_Rhl-1lgYN84.zip; rollback = restore that s3Key.
